author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Send EVE to syslog (eve-log type: syslog, identity suricata). alert records go to NIDS, dns to DNS and flow to Netflow; other event types stay in generic. Samples follow the EVE format page with made-up values. Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13. On 2026-10-14 each child also passed Run Test in a lab tenant as a separate parser under its parent. The tenant's built-in suricata_generic parser matches the same lines and normalizes nothing; the engine picks one parser per line, and in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 it took the alert lines in 9 of 11 Run Tests and the flow lines in 5 of 11. Expect some lines to keep the built-in mapping.
